pages.title: Command Framework, Plugins, and Error Handling
pages.purpose: How commands are registered and rendered (urfave/cli, cli-utils/command, usage templates), how plugins are discovered and executed, and the STEPDEBUG/panic error-handling behavior.

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Ownership boundaries, package layout, entrypoints, and the overall data/control flow of the step CLI across command groups, the cli-utils command registry, and shared flags.

pages.title: STEPPATH, Configuration, and Contexts
pages.purpose: Persistence model of the step CLI: $STEPPATH layout, defaults.json, root certificates, contexts, profiles, and the step path/context commands.

pages.title: ACME and Bootstrap Flows
pages.purpose: The ACME client flows (http-01 standalone/webroot challenge modes, EAB, CSR flow) and the bootstrap flows that download and persist root certificates and defaults.json.

pages.title: CA Client and Certificate Flows
pages.purpose: The CaClient interface, online vs offline client construction, the admin client with x5c credentials, and the CertificateFlow used by sign/renew/revoke/rekey across X.509 and SSH.

pages.title: Provisioning Tokens
pages.purpose: The token package and flows that produce one-time JWT provisioning tokens: claim construction, signing, parsing/type detection, and the online/offline token flows across provisioner types.

pages.title: The step ca Command Group
pages.purpose: Subcommands and mechanics of step ca: init, bootstrap, token, certificate, renew, revoke, rekey, root, roots, federation, health, sign, provisioner, admin, policy, acme.

pages.title: The step certificate Command Group
pages.purpose: Subcommands and mechanics of step certificate: create, sign, inspect, verify, lint, bundle, fingerprint, needsRenewal, format, key, install/uninstall, p12.

pages.title: The step crypto Command Group and step oauth
pages.purpose: The cryptographic plumbing commands (jose, jwk, jws, jwt, jwe, kdf, key, nacl, otp, hash, rand, winpe, change-pass, keypair) and the step oauth OAuth/OIDC flows.

pages.title: The step ssh Command Group
pages.purpose: Subcommands and mechanics of step ssh and the sshutil helpers: certificate, login/logout, agent integration, config, check-host, hosts, proxycommand, renew/rekey/revoke.

pages.title: Build, Test, and Release
pages.purpose: How the CLI is built, tested, linted, and released: Makefile targets, GoReleaser configuration, version injection via ldflags, shell completions, and packaging assets.

pages.title: Change Guides
pages.purpose: Focused guides for representative maintenance tasks: adding a new command, adding a new flag, changing token claims, and changing how errors surface, with test commands.

pages.title: Quickstart
pages.purpose: Practical getting-started guide: build, layout, and the most common step workflows (certificate creation, CA bootstrap, token issuance) with source pointers.
